ADDED i3: A lone dash, or any run of only dashes, collapses to the single literal '-'.
ADDED i4: A dash next to a single other character stays two separate literals, because a range needs the dash to sit between two characters.
ADDED i5: With three characters, the parser reads a range from the first to the third character; the middle dash is the range separator.
